g.text: Optimization searches the feasible region shaped by all design constraints
Hypothetical dimensionless objective and linear constraints. Green polygon is the joint feasible set; lower contour values are better. Constraint meanings
are illustrative, not site limits. Feasible optimum J=4.5 lies on x+y=5; the unconstrained optimum violates capacity, safety and environmental
